name: Welcome (with date) — variant 1
description: First-touch welcome with roadshow date anchor.

content_json.text: Hi there! 👋 Thanks for reaching out to Dent Adavista. We'll be in Ireland for our upcoming roadshow — free consultations and full dental x-rays, no commitment. Happy to answer any questions you have about the visit.

name: Welcome (with date) — variant 2
description: Warmer opener, roadshow context.

content_json.text: Hello! Great to hear from you. Dent Adavista is coming to Ireland soon for a roadshow weekend — complimentary consultation plus dental x-ray, zero obligation. What would you like to know?

name: Welcome (with date) — variant 3
description: Benefit-led opener.

content_json.text: Hi! Thanks for your message. We're hosting a Dent Adavista roadshow in Ireland — free dental check + x-ray, our senior dentist reviews your case on the spot. No pressure, no cost. How can I help?

name: Welcome (with date) — variant 4
description: Informal, curiosity-first.

content_json.text: Hey, welcome! 🦷 We're running an Ireland roadshow shortly — free consultation + x-ray with no commitment to treat. Thought you might want a quick look at your options. What's on your mind?

name: Welcome (with date) — variant 5
description: Reassurance + date mention.

content_json.text: Hi! Glad you reached out. Dent Adavista visits Ireland once in a while — next stop is coming up. Free on-site consultation and full x-ray, you walk away with a treatment plan if you want one, nothing more. Ask me anything.

name: Welcome (with date) — variant 6
description: Direct + value-first.

content_json.text: Hello and welcome! Our Ireland roadshow is just around the corner. In one 30-minute visit you get a full dental exam, x-ray, and a plan — free and no obligation. What questions can I answer for you?

name: Welcome (with date) — variant 7
description: Community tone.

content_json.text: Hi there! 😊 Dent Adavista is back in Ireland for another roadshow. Folks come in, we take an x-ray, our dentist talks through what's going on and what your options look like — free, and you're never obligated to do anything. What would you like to know first?

name: Welcome (no date) — variant 1
description: Post-registration follow-up, no date yet.

content_json.text: Hi! Thanks so much for registering with Dent Adavista. 🙏 As soon as we lock in the next Ireland roadshow date, you'll be among the first to hear. In the meantime, feel free to ask anything — treatment, prices, how it all works.

name: Welcome (no date) — variant 2
description: Registration thank-you + open door.

content_json.text: Welcome aboard! We've got your details safely and you'll get a message the moment our next Ireland visit is confirmed. Until then, any dental questions — shoot. Happy to help.

name: Welcome (no date) — variant 3
description: Casual + informational.

content_json.text: Hi! Great to have you on the list. Dates for the next Ireland roadshow are being finalised — you'll hear from us as soon as they're set. Anything you'd like to know about Dent Adavista in the meantime?

name: Welcome (no date) — variant 4
description: Appreciation + curiosity.

content_json.text: Hello! Thanks for signing up. 😊 We'll reach out with Ireland roadshow dates as soon as they're confirmed — no spam, just the update. Want to know anything about our clinic, the visit format, or pricing while you wait?

name: Welcome (no date) — variant 5
description: Short, warm.

content_json.text: Hi and welcome! You're now on our Ireland roadshow list — we'll message you the minute dates are finalised. Got a question about the clinic or treatment? Just ask.

name: FAQ: Is it free / pricing — v1
description: Response pool for is_it_free intent (free/cost/pay/charge).

content_json.text: Great question — the roadshow consultation and the dental x-ray are completely free, no strings attached. If you decide to move ahead with treatment at our Istanbul clinic, we'll share a personalised quote based on your case.

name: FAQ: Is it free / pricing — v2
description: Response pool for is_it_free intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: No charge for the consultation or the x-ray — those are on us. Treatment itself happens at our Istanbul clinic and is quoted individually after your dentist sees your case. We'll always show the numbers before anything starts.

name: FAQ: Is it free / pricing — v3
description: Response pool for is_it_free intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: The Ireland visit is 100% free — exam, x-ray, and talking through your options cost you nothing. You only pay if you choose to travel to Istanbul for actual treatment, and even then you'll have the full quote in hand beforehand.

name: FAQ: Where / location — v1
description: Response pool for location_where intent (address, hotel).

content_json.text: We host in Dublin and Cork — the venues are central hotels, with the exact address confirmed closer to the date. Once the roadshow is officially scheduled, you'll get a message with hotel name, room, and timing details.

name: FAQ: Where / location — v2
description: Response pool for location_where intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Roadshow takes place at a hotel in Dublin and another in Cork — both city-centre, easy to reach. The specific venue is shared a few days before so everyone gets the correct address. Can I ask which city is more convenient for you?

name: FAQ: Where / location — v3
description: Response pool for location_where intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Two stops — Dublin first, then Cork. We pick well-connected hotels so attendees don't have to travel far. I'll share the exact address, room, and your appointment slot as soon as the date is finalised.

name: FAQ: What happens / agenda — v1
description: Response pool for what_happens intent.

content_json.text: It's a 30-45 minute appointment: we take a full dental x-ray, our dentist examines you, we sit down and go over what's going on, and you leave with a written treatment plan and price. No selling, no pressure — just clear info.

name: FAQ: What happens / agenda — v2
description: Response pool for what_happens intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Simple flow: check in, quick x-ray, proper exam with the dentist, then a conversation about what's needed and what it costs if you want to move ahead. The whole thing is about 30-45 minutes. You walk out with a plan and can decide in your own time.

name: FAQ: What happens / agenda — v3
description: Response pool for what_happens intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: You'll spend roughly half an hour with us. First we do the x-ray, then the dentist walks through your mouth and the images with you, and finally we put together a clear treatment plan with pricing. No obligation afterwards.

name: FAQ: Treatment on site — v1
description: Response pool for any_treatment intent.

content_json.text: Treatment itself happens at our main clinic in Istanbul — the Ireland roadshow is for consultation, x-ray, and planning only. That way you can see our senior dentist in person, get an honest view of what you need, and decide whether to travel.

name: FAQ: Treatment on site — v2
description: Response pool for any_treatment intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: No actual dental work on the day — the roadshow is purely for assessment and planning. All treatment (implants, crowns, veneers, etc.) is done at our Istanbul clinic where we have the full setup, lab, and recovery support.

name: FAQ: Treatment on site — v3
description: Response pool for any_treatment intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: The Ireland visit is consultation only — exam, x-ray, treatment plan, quote. The actual treatment is performed at our dedicated Istanbul clinic, which has its own in-house lab, sterile surgery rooms, and a team that handles your whole stay.

name: FAQ: Payment / commitment after — v1
description: Response pool for payment_after intent (obligation, commit).

content_json.text: Zero commitment. You get the consultation, x-ray, and full treatment plan with pricing, and then you're free to take weeks to decide — or not proceed at all. We'd rather you think it over than feel rushed.

name: FAQ: Payment / commitment after — v2
description: Response pool for payment_after intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Nothing binds you. Once you've seen your plan and the price, you can say yes, say no, or say 'let me think about it'. There's no deposit, no signature, no follow-up hassle from us.

name: FAQ: Payment / commitment after — v3
description: Response pool for payment_after intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: You're never under obligation. The roadshow is designed as a 'get real information, go home and think' service. If you want to book treatment, great. If you want to compare with other options, that's fine too.

name: FAQ: Bring xray — v1
description: Response pool for bring_xray intent (xray, x-ray, scan).

content_json.text: If you already have a recent x-ray or scan, bring it along — it helps us cross-check. But don't worry if you don't, we'll take a fresh dental x-ray for you on the day as part of the free consultation.

name: FAQ: Bring xray — v2
description: Response pool for bring_xray intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: You don't need to bring anything — we do the x-ray on site with our own equipment. That said, if you have a recent scan from another dentist, feel free to share it; it just gives us more context.

name: FAQ: Bring xray — v3
description: Response pool for bring_xray intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Not required — our setup includes a digital dental x-ray, so you'll get one fresh during the visit. If you happen to already have imaging, bring it if convenient; otherwise just show up.

name: FAQ: Bring companion — v1
description: Response pool for bring_companion intent (friend, family).

content_json.text: Of course, bring anyone you like. A lot of our visitors come with a partner or family member — sometimes they book their own slot too. Just let us know ahead so we can plan the schedule.

name: FAQ: Bring companion — v2
description: Response pool for bring_companion intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Absolutely — partners, parents, friends are all welcome. If they'd like their own exam we can book them in separately. Does anyone plan to join you?

name: FAQ: Bring companion — v3
description: Response pool for bring_companion intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Yes, please feel free. Many attendees bring someone along for a second opinion or just company. If your companion wants a consultation of their own, I can save them a slot — just share a name and number.

name: FAQ: Duration — v1
description: Response pool for duration intent (how long, time).

content_json.text: Plan for around 30-45 minutes. That covers the x-ray, the exam, and a proper sit-down conversation about your plan and costs. Simpler cases are a bit quicker, more complex ones can run a little longer.

name: FAQ: Duration — v2
description: Response pool for duration intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Usually about half an hour, sometimes up to 45 minutes. We never rush — if your case needs more time to explain properly, we take it. Plan for an hour in your day to be safe.

name: FAQ: Duration — v3
description: Response pool for duration intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: The visit itself is short — 30 to 45 minutes is normal. Parking, checking in at the hotel, and chatting afterwards might add a little on top, but you'll easily be done within the hour.

name: FAQ: Why Ireland — v1
description: Response pool for why_ireland intent.

content_json.text: Many of our Istanbul patients have come from Ireland over the years, and we kept hearing 'I wish I could talk to a dentist in person before flying'. So we started these roadshows — a local, no-obligation way to get real answers before making any decisions.

name: FAQ: Why Ireland — v2
description: Response pool for why_ireland intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Ireland is a strong community for us — enough returning patients that flying them over first just didn't make sense. The roadshow lets people meet our dentist, see their own x-ray, and ask questions without any travel commitment.

name: FAQ: Why Ireland — v3
description: Response pool for why_ireland intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Short answer: people ask for it. We've had enough Irish visitors over the years that local pop-ups made sense. It's also the fairest way to share pricing — we'd rather you meet us face-to-face than book treatment based on a website alone.

name: FAQ: Price quote — v1
description: Response pool for price_quote intent + fallback link.

content_json.text: Pricing depends on your specific case — nobody should quote you properly without seeing your x-ray. Rough ranges are on our website, but the real number comes from your consultation. Want me to share the general pricing page in the meantime?

name: FAQ: Price quote — v2
description: Response pool for price_quote intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Honest answer: we can't give a real quote without the x-ray and exam. Ballpark prices for common treatments are published on our site — I can share the link. The exact figure for your case comes from the roadshow visit, in writing.

name: FAQ: Price quote — v3
description: Response pool for price_quote intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Exact quote needs the consultation — treatment depends on gum condition, bone density, number of units, etc. Our website has indicative prices for implants, crowns, veneers so you can gauge. The roadshow gives you the precise, personalised number.

name: FAQ: Safety / social proof — v1
description: Response pool for safety_concern intent + social links inject.

content_json.text: Completely understand the hesitation — health care abroad is a big decision. Dent Adavista has served patients for over 15 years, with thousands of international cases. You'll see real before/after photos, patient reviews, and our dentist's credentials on Instagram and our website. Happy to share any links you'd like to see.

name: FAQ: Safety / social proof — v2
description: Response pool for safety_concern intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: That's a fair question and we get it often. Our clinic is fully licensed, our lead dentist has decades of experience, and we've treated patients from across Europe including Ireland. We can send you reviews, patient stories, and our social media — seeing is easier than me describing.

name: FAQ: Safety / social proof — v3
description: Response pool for safety_concern intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: Good question to ask — always. We're an established Istanbul clinic with credentials, licences, and a visible track record online (Instagram, Google reviews, before/after gallery). Want me to share a few direct links so you can see the real work before deciding anything?

name: FAQ: Hotel / transfers — v1
description: Response pool for hotel_transfers intent (hotel, transfer, flight).

content_json.text: For the Ireland roadshow itself: no flights, no hotels — we come to you in Dublin or Cork, the visit is a few hours. For actual treatment in Istanbul we handle airport pickup, hotel booking, and daily clinic transfers. You just book the flight and we take care of the rest once you arrive.

name: FAQ: Hotel / transfers — v2
description: Response pool for hotel_transfers intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: The roadshow is local for you — just walk into a Dublin or Cork hotel for your slot, no travel on your side. If you later come to Istanbul, we organise the hotel and a driver for every clinic day, included in your package.

name: FAQ: Hotel / transfers — v3
description: Response pool for hotel_transfers intent — alternate phrasing.

content_json.text: No hotel or transfer needed for the Ireland visit — you drop in, we see you, you go home the same day. If you decide on treatment later, your Istanbul package includes airport pickup, hotel stay near the clinic, and daily transfers throughout your treatment.
